name: Nightbeast VR
detailed_description:
Nightbeast is a VR Action game. With mission-based game segments, you can experience different scenarios with the added immersion of VR. Features in the game include:

Nightbeast's Home
A mission awaits you at Nightbeast's Home. This central hub provides an ideal space for players to test their skills, identify targets, and enhance their strategic shooting abilities. In our shooting range, you can score by hitting targets and hone your skills.

Mission Mode
Nightbeast VR currently offers one mission. Utilize your marksmanship skills to neutralize assigned targets and complete challenging missions.

Survival Mode
Survival mode offers players the chance to confront challenging waves of incoming enemies. However, remember that a true hitman in Nightbeast VR should be prepared for any situation.

Weapons
The game currently provides players with two pistol options. This dual pistol system heightens the speed and excitement of the action while offering opportunities for strategic diversity and skill development. Master these pistols in various in-game modes to become a true professional.

Early Access
In mission mode, you neutralize targets and complete challenging missions using your hitman skills. Survival mode allows players to face challenging enemy waves, emphasizing the importance of a hitman being prepared for any situation. The game intensifies the pace of action and offers opportunities for strategic diversity and skill development by currently providing two pistol options.

short_description: Nightbeast is a VR shooter where players enter the criminal underworld, becoming skilled marksmen, and boldly confronting ruthless foes as they complete contracts and deliver justice.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7500 / Ryzen 5 3600 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1070 or better
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
  • VR Support: Meta Quest VR Headsets
  • Additional Notes: Development still in progress, we will be supporting more headset in the future.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
